✔️ Development of an AI-based wildfire response support system

snippet.title: K-방산 진입장벽 완화…중소기업 참여 확대 MOU 체결
snippet.description:
2026년 3월 6일 판교 이노밸리에서
K-방산 진입장벽 완화를 위한 업무협약식이 열렸습니다.

한국방산혁신기업협회와 이노비즈협회가

중소기업의 방산 진입을 적극 지원할 계획입니다.

유망 기업 발굴부터 납품, 수출까지
K-방산의 글로벌 경쟁력 강화를 위한 협력이 시작됩니다.

en-US.title: Easing Entry Barriers to K-Defense Industry… MOU Signed to Expand SME Participation
en-US.description:
On March 6, 2026, a signing ceremony for a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) aimed at easing entry barriers to the K-Defense industry was held at Pangyo Inno Valley.

The Korea Defense Innovation Enterprise Association and the InnoBiz Association signed an MOU to commercialize defense technologies and expand sales channels, thereby launching a full-scale initiative to integrate civilian technologies into the defense sector.

The Defense Acquisition Program Administration and the Ministry of SMEs and Startups discussed the establishment of a dedicated TIPS track for the defense industry and the implementation of large-scale defense R&D projects, planning to actively support the entry of SMEs into the defense sector.

Cooperation begins to strengthen the global competitiveness of the K-Defense industry, spanning from the discovery of promising companies to product supply and export.
